description:
VERSATILE ALL-ROUNDER FOR EVERYDAY LIFE

The HILAND Bloomer 26-inch mountain bike is the perfect companion for both men and women (unisex) with a height of 150 to 170 cm. Whether for the daily city commute, relaxed leisure rides, forest paths, or gravel roads – this MTB combines sporty performance with maximum riding comfort.

EFFICIENT & RELIABLE 7-SPEED GEAR SYSTEM

Equipped with a precise 7-speed derailleur system, this entry-level mountain bike offers the ideal balance of easy handling and flexibility. Experience effortless, precise, and low-maintenance gear changes, making this bike the perfect alternative to traditional city and trekking bikes.

MAXIMUM SAFETY WITH DUAL DISC BRAKES

Reliable mechanical disc brakes on both the front and rear wheels guarantee optimal braking power and secure control in any situation. Whether facing sudden rain, wet roads, or uneven terrain – you benefit from short braking distances and maximum safety in traffic and off-road.

LIGHTWEIGHT & ROBUST ALUMINUM FRAME

The high-quality hardtail aluminum frame combines minimal weight with maximum stability. The agile hardtail design ensures direct power transfer, a sporty riding feel, and long-lasting durability – ideal for commuters and recreational riders who value quality.

SPORTY DESIGN WITH COMFORT ERGONOMICS

The HILAND Bloomer blends a modern, athletic look with an ergonomic and comfortable seating position. As an affordable, durable 26-inch adult bicycle, it meets all the requirements of a modern everyday and leisure bike for style-conscious riders across Europe.
